notes: rank: 1 is best. Sizes are decimal GB of the artifact (weights; mmproj = vision projector). arch numbers describe KV-cache layers: full-attention layers grow with context, swa_* layers are capped at swa_window tokens; Qwen3.5-family linear-attention layers keep a small fixed state and are not listed. Chat models are ordered by ability from published benchmark scores (evidence.py); rank only breaks ties and orders other roles. evidence points at the repo whose scores apply (build: true when they were measured on this exact build).
